title: Uncovering internal sensory evidence reveals the nature of confidence computation in multi-alternative perceptual decision making.
title_zh: 揭示内部感觉证据揭示多替代感知决策中置信度计算的本质
abstract: A central goal of perceptual decision making is to determine the computations underlying choice and confidence in complex, multi-alternative tasks. However, revealing these computations requires knowledge of the internal sensory evidence upon which the computations operate. Unfortunately, unlike for two-choice tasks, there is no established method in multi-alternative tasks to determine how stimuli are transformed into internal sensory evidence. Here we address this critical gap by developing a novel modeling paradigm that reveals how the brain transforms external stimuli into internal sensory evidence during multi-alternative decision making in the context of numerosity tasks. Across three experiments that feature two-, three-, and five-choice conditions, we show that the internal sensory evidence in our numerosity task can be described with a simple, two-parameter equation that fits data for up to 12 conditions. Critically, the ability to model the internal sensory evidence allowed us to test six theories of confidence computation. Our results support a model where confidence reflects the raw evidence difference between the top two alternatives. These results establish a new numerosity paradigm in which a two-parameter equation can be used to determine the internal sensory evidence for a potentially unlimited number of multi-alternative conditions and reveal the confidence computation in multi-alternative tasks. abstract_zh: 感知决策的一个核心目标是确定复杂多替代任务中选择和置信度的底层计算。然而，揭示这些计算需要了解计算所基于的内部感觉证据。不幸的是，与两选任务不同，在多替代任务中尚无既定方法来确定刺激如何转化为内部感觉证据。在此，我们通过开发一种新的建模范式，解决了这一关键缺口，揭示了大脑在数量任务的多替代决策中如何将外部刺激转化为内部感觉证据。在三个包含两选、三选和五选条件的实验中，我们表明，我们的数量任务中的内部感觉证据可以用一个简单的二参数方程来描述，该方程可拟合最多12种条件的数据。关键的是，能够对内部感觉证据进行建模，使我们得以检验六种置信度计算理论。我们的结果支持一种模型，即置信度反映前两种替代方案之间的原始证据差异。这些结果建立了一个新的数量范式，在该范式中，一个二参数方程可用于确定潜在无限数量的多替代条件的内部感觉证据，并揭示多替代任务中的置信度计算。(PsycInfo 数据库记录（c）2026 APA，保留所有权利)。
